authority: Static House Tang force-employment, recruiting, training and private-service policy. Exact people, manpower, contracts, money and operations remain in their existing mutable owners.

recruitment.rule: House Tang creates no direct autonomous regular recruits. Every new regular fighting body enters through a real Sword Manor trainee vacancy, conserved Qin population, screening and elapsed training, then advances only through registered promotion gates, vacancies, mounts and equipment.

training.smart_rotation: prioritize next lawful promotion deficits; then current loadout and troop-type skills; then command/logistics needs; then the weakest useful registered stats; rotate deterministically so one already-high stat cannot monopolize training
training.named_people: eligible requested adult House Tang/Sword Manor/Tang Wei/Qin-assigned commanders use the same max-sustainable regimen through exact-person activity contracts; Tang Kai remains age-appropriate only
training.person_lite: House Tang, Sword Manor and Wei-designated Qin 1,000/500 officers train as conserved person-lite bodies through their exact force owners

force_employment.principle: Spend replaceable money before scarce long-trained House lives when a lawful available mercenary solution can accomplish the mission.
constraints: Mercenary preference never overrides a direct protected-life emergency, explicit sovereign duty, exact command order, route impossibility, company refusal, insolvency, or lack of suitable available contractors.
Mercenary contracts organize service only and never transfer body ownership to House Tang.
Sword Manor is a private House institution; it does not train outsiders for tuition or public enrollment.
House regulars remain available when the mission genuinely requires their quality, loyalty, speed, command integration or political authority.

contingency_mercenary_procurement.review: House causal review plus material threat/war wake
contingency_mercenary_procurement.rule: Offers are made only to exact available short-notice companies and must pass fair-pay and House treasury checks; accepted contracts are funded from treasury_house_tang and remain independent manpower owners.

sword_manor_private_work.rule: Completed private jobs use only unallocated eligible disciples, are zero-body service contracts, and transfer real market cash to House Tang. Duty is a bounded assignment, not extra manpower or free training.
